<thought>To fulfill the task, I will:
1. Define a diverse set of nitride compositions (≤ 40, using common binary and ternary nitrides).
2. Use **batch_retrieve_polymorphs** with the given limits (max_energy_above_hull = 0.3 eV/atom, max_per_composition = 3) and store the files in a dedicated directory.
3. Build a mapping from each composition to its generated JSON file path.
4. Consolidate all individual polymorph JSON files into a single dataset using **consolidate_polymorph_datasets**.
5. Return the path to the consolidated JSON file.

The chosen directory will be  
`/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/6/1_batch_retrieve_nitride_polymorphs_trial_9/nitride_polymorphs`.

The final consolidated file will be  
`/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/6/1_batch_retrieve_nitride_polymorphs_trial_9/nitride_polymorphs/consolidated_polymorphs.json`.
